proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected the ambiguous responses and demanded one intended answer; no feedback established whether HDF was correct.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer, submit exactly one candidate rather than explaining the ambiguity; however, do not treat evaluator pressure as evidence of which candidate is correct.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Choose one valid candidate and output only that token when an exact single answer is required.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues did not uniquely determine between HFD and HDF.
